title: MATCHA: A Chinese Multi-Disorder Mental Health Dataset with Cross-Lingual Analyses on Social Media
abstract: arXiv:2610.35512v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mental health research on social media has been dominated by English-language datasets and DSM-5-centered resources, limiting cross-lingual and cross-cultural understanding of online mental health expression. We introduce MATCHA, the first Chinese multi-disorder mental health dataset that links disorder-specific Weibo Super-Topic communities with users' broader public timelines. MATCHA covers seven DSM-5 disorders and a control group, comprising 46,025 cohort-level users and 1.8 million posts. The dataset distinguishes users with explicit self-disclosure evidence from broader disorder-related participants through an LLM-assisted annotation pipeline, and is released in a rigorously de-identified, controlled-access format. Using MATCHA, we analyze behavioral, linguistic, symptom-related, and life-event-related patterns across disorders, and conduct cross-lingual comparisons with Twitter-STMHD. translated_title: MATCHA：一个中文多障碍心理健康数据集及基于社交媒体的跨语言分析
translated_abstract: 社交媒体上的心理健康研究长期被英语数据集和以DSM-5为中心的资源所主导，这限制了对在线心理健康表达的跨语言与跨文化理解。我们提出了MATCHA，这是首个中文多障碍心理健康数据集，它将特定障碍相关的微博超话社区与用户更广泛的公开时间线相连接。MATCHA涵盖七种DSM-5障碍及一个对照组，包含46,025名队列级用户和180万条帖子。该数据集通过大语言模型（LLM）辅助的标注流程，将具有明确自我披露证据的用户与更广泛的障碍相关参与者区分开来，并以严格去标识化、受控访问的形式发布。利用MATCHA，我们分析了各障碍在行为、语言、症状及生活事件方面的模式，并与Twitter-STMHD数据集进行了跨语言比较。我们的分析表明，微博超话发挥着……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: MATCHA是首个中文多障碍心理健康数据集，将七种DSM-5障碍的微博超话社区与用户公开时间线关联，支持跨语言、跨文化的社交媒体心理健康研究。
